objective_signal.condition: Both legs contact ground (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1) and not terminated and |state[0]| < 0.1 and |state[1]| < 0.1 and |state[3]| < 0.1 and |state[4]| < 0.1
objective_signal.description: Large reward for successful landing on pad with low velocity and upright angle.

distance_to_pad_delta.description: Progress-delta penalty for distance from pad: only penalizes when distance increases, rewards when distance decreases.

vertical_speed.description: Penalize high vertical speed to encourage soft landing.

angle.description: Penalize tilt angle to encourage upright posture.

horizontal_correction_bonus.description: Bonus for using right orientation engine when horizontal velocity is away from pad (vx * x > 0). Encourages centering.

coast_bonus.condition: action == 0 and near_pad (|x|<0.1 and |y|<0.1) and low_speed (|vy|<0.1) and upright (|angle|<0.1)
coast_bonus.description: Bonus for using action 0 (do nothing) when the lander is near the pad with low speed and upright angle. Encourages coasting to a stable landing.

main_engine_fuel.description: Penalize main engine usage to minimize fuel consumption.

orientation_engine_fuel.description: Mild penalty for orientation engine use.

crash_or_out_of_bounds.condition: terminated and not (both legs contact and success conditions)
crash_or_out_of_bounds.description: Strong negative reward for crashing or going out of bounds.
